A '''Stage Three torpedo''' was a modified [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] designed to disrupt [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] when detonated. The [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] was equipped with them.
